title: Which Shell?
lines: Ted and Phil check ten shells in the sun.
"Which shell do you want?" said Phil.
A thin red shell sits in a gap.
When he digs, he can not get it.
Phil gets a rod and Ted digs at it.
The shell pops up. Ted has it!
Then Ted digs and gets a shell as well.
"That shell is your shell," said Ted.

questions.ask: Where was the thin red shell?
questions.listenFor: Down in a gap. Line three says it. If they guess, send them back to that line.

questions.ask: How did Ted get the shell out of the gap?
questions.listenFor: Phil fetched a long rod and Ted dug with it. Line five says it. Two children, one job.

questions.ask: Ted dug a second shell out and gave it to Phil. Why do you think he did that? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any sensible idea works. You are listening for a reason of their own, like Phil helped him first.
